versions.short: The bill would update several sections of federal law governing inspectors general, federal advisory committees, and ethics and financial disclosure rules, mainly by adding in changes made by laws passed after October 19, 2021, so the code reflects current law. It would also fix related technical errors such as outdated references and mistaken wording. The bill states that these edits would not change the meaning or effect of existing law. Its main areas are inspector general rules, including removal, placement on non-duty status, acting leaders, and reporting; federal judges' financial disclosure reports; and the Bureau of Prisons inspection regime. It would also update cross-references to the Inspector General Act and the Federal Advisory Committee Act in many other statutes.
